name: KeyModifier
code:
KeyModifier = enum
  modCommand,               ## the Command (⌘) key  -> "command down"
  modOption,                ## the Option/Alt (⌥) key -> "option down"
  modControl,               ## the Control (⌃) key  -> "control down"
  modShift                   ## the Shift (⇧) key    -> "shift down"
